sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Water Release

system.description:
You conjure multiple hands of wood that jut from the ground and attempt to grapple up to two creatures you can see within range. Target creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, being grappled on a failed save or avoiding the grasping hands on a successful save with no further effects.

A grappled creature is pulled to the ground if they were airborne. A grappled creature also takes 3d8 Earth or Cold damage at the beginning of each of their turns and can make a Strength saving throw breaking free on a success.

While grappling a creature, the wooden hands generate a 15-foot radius of difficult terrain which is treated as New Growth for the purpose of interacting with Senju features and Jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and select one additional creature for this jutsu to affect.
